ideas.title: Minnesota Medicaid Fraud: A Deeper Dive
ideas.description: Investigate the guilty plea in the largest Medicaid fraud case in Minnesota's history and explore the implications for the state's healthcare system.
questions: What were the details of the fraud?
How did the perpetrators carry out the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story could explore the details of the fraud, the impact on Minnesota's healthcare system, and the efforts to prevent similar cases in the future.
